explanation: It is 0 at GO, at D2, and at every D1 that follows a rewarded trial. It spikes to about 10 only at the D1 just after an unrewarded trial (common or rare) that ended a run of rewarded a1 choices, mostly in trials 10-45; it is 0-2 when the loss came after another loss, when the agent has been choosing a2, or late in the episode (after about trial 70).
